description: Compare a stated deviation numerically against the ISO 2768-1 general-tolerance value for one dimension. This is only a numeric comparison: first establish that the dimension has no individual tolerance indication, because the general tolerance applies only to unmarked dimensions. The result does not establish process capability.

nominal.description: Nominal size, or the shorter side of an angle.

stated_deviation.description: The deviation the drawing actually states for this dimension, in millimetres (or degrees for angular). Sign is ignored: the tables are symmetric.

tolerance_class.description: Class letter from the drawing note, e.g. m.

name: general_tolerance_complies
title: Check a Deviation Against an ISO 2768-1 Note
